description: This file is a Jupyter Notebook source file containing a sequence of markdown explanations and code cells that demonstrate testing and evaluating multiple large language model (LLM) providers using the LiteLLM library. The notebook covers topics like quality testing, load testing, and duration testing, with code for installing dependencies, importing functions, defining test prompts, and visualizing results.
